Your contract for the Naturalness role has ended.
Your final payout will be processed in line with our regular payment schedule.
Your skills are still in high demand, and we encourage you to explore and apply to other opportunities that match your expertise.
Next steps for Generalist Expert role
Congratulations on accepting your offer. You’re now ready to get started. For your next steps, please:
Reach out to your point of contact if you have further questions. You’ll find their name and email in the onboarding instructions.
Instant Work Offer for a role
James, you've received an instant work offer for a role.

We know you didn't apply directly - this offer comes through Mercor's matching system, which surfaced your qualifications from a previous interview. After reviewing your profile, the hiring manager agreed that you'd be a strong fit.
Mercor connects you with opportunities from anywhere in the world.
Visit the Mercor Explore Page to start applying for positions. Applications typically involve a resume upload, an AI interview, and some role-specific questions.
Track your connections and their job matches.
Unlock more earnings with Mercor Intros
You decide who to introduce and what gets sent. Mercor handles the invite, so you don't need to reach out personally.
